title: Crispy Vietnamese Tofu Noodle Soup
description: A flavorful and comforting soup that combines crispy tofu with the savory flavors of Vietnamese cuisine, all in a bowl of steaming hot noodles.

ingredients.name: lovely crispy tofu
ingredients.notes: Press and drain excess moisture before cutting into bite-sized cubes

ingredients.name: vietnamese noodles
ingredients.notes: Choose a rice noodle for the best texture and flavor

ingredients.name: lovely vegetable broth
ingredients.notes: Use low-sodium broth for a healthier option

ingredients.name: vietnamese fish sauce
ingredients.notes: Adjust to taste for the perfect balance of flavor

ingredients.name: lovely fresh cilantro
ingredients.notes: Chop the leaves for garnish and add a pop of color

ingredients.name: lovely lime juice
ingredients.notes: Squeeze the juice for a burst of citrus flavor

ingredients.name: lovely chili flakes
ingredients.notes: Adjust to taste for the perfect level of heat

ingredients.name: lovely sesame oil
ingredients.notes: Use a neutral oil for a lighter flavor

ingredients.name: lovely salt
ingredients.notes: Use a flaky salt for a more delicate flavor

ingredients.name: lovely black pepper
ingredients.notes: Use a coarse grind for a more robust flavor

instructions: In a large pot, heat 2 tbsp of sesame oil over medium heat.
Add 1 tsp of chili flakes and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add 4 cups of lovely vegetable broth and bring to a simmer.
Add 1 package of vietnamese noodles and cook according to package instructions.
While the noodles cook, prepare the crispy tofu by cutting it into bite-sized cubes and coating with a mixture of 1 tsp of lovely sesame oil and 1 tsp of lovely salt.
Heat 1 tsp of lovely sesame oil in a pan over medium-high heat and cook the tofu cubes until crispy and golden brown.
Add 2 tbsp of vietnamese fish sauce, 2 tbsp of lovely lime juice, and 1 tsp of lovely black pepper to the pot and stir to combine.
Add the cooked noodles to the pot and stir to combine.
Garnish with chopped lovely fresh cilantro and serve immediately.
